highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.5 backports Apple platform TFM updates and fixes the WinUI Projection DLL for .NET 9.

bullets.lead: Apple 26.0 library TFMs and unversioned app TFMs backported
bullets.detail: Native library targets now use the versioned 26.0 TFM and app targets use the unversioned forms, aligning v3 with the Apple platform conventions introduced in v4.

bullets.lead: WinUI Projection DLL not found on .NET 9 fixed
bullets.detail: The WinUI projection assembly was not resolved correctly in .NET 9 consumer projects. The package now includes the correct resolution path.

contributor_summaries.drasticactions: Backported the Apple 26.0 library and unversioned app TFM alignment from v4.
